headline: Mercedes-Benz Cuts 2026 Profit Forecast Amid Chinese Market Competition
summary: Mercedes-Benz lowered its full-year 2026 profit guidance, citing sluggish demand in China and rising raw material costs. The announcement follows similar outlook reductions from German rivals Volkswagen and BMW.
why: Mercedes-Benz is a premium global automaker; declining earnings highlight structural challenges for European luxury carmakers competing in China's rapidly evolving EV market.
why_moved: Lower guidance underscores softening premium vehicle demand in key markets like China, impacting revenue and margin projections across the auto sector.
